payments.retryPaymentConfirmDescription: The payment will be retried with the provider using the same amount, source and destination.
payments.resendReceiptConfirmDescription: An email with this payment's receipt will be sent to the recipient.
payments.retryPayoutConfirmDescription: The payout of {{amount}} will be sent to the operator again, towards {{account}}, under the reference {{reference}}. This moves real money and cannot be undone.
payments.collectionCannotBeRetried: A collection is debited from the passenger's own mobile money account and needs their PIN: the back-office cannot replay it.
payments.pendingNote: Awaiting operator confirmation. No action required yet.
payments.search: Search a reference, number or name
payments.refundConfirmDescription: The amount leaves the merchant account towards {{account}}. This cannot be undone and will be recorded in the ledger under reference {{reference}}.
payments.refundReducesDriverPayout: If the booking is still standing, the refunded amount is also taken off what the driver is paid. It is refused once the driver payout has been sent.
payments.refundFailed: The refund failed — see the reason on the new ledger entry

chargedPending.title: Charged bookings to settle ({{count}})
chargedPending.description: These passengers paid but their booking was never confirmed. Keep the seat for them, or give the money back.
chargedPending.confirmDescription: {{name}} paid {{amount}}. The booking is confirmed, the passenger is put on the ride and both sides are notified.
chargedPending.refundDescription: {{amount}} goes back to {{name}}, the booking is closed and its seats are put back on sale. This cannot be undone.
chargedPending.reasonHelper: Say why, for example whether the seat was still free. It is the only record of this decision.
chargedPending.refundSuccess: The booking was closed and the refund was initiated

payments.alreadyRefunded: This payment has already been refunded in full.
payments.scopedToUser: The list is limited to the payments of a single account.
payments.scopedToUserWithName: The list is limited to the payments of “{{value}}”.
payments.manualReasonHelper: Required. Say why you are doing this: it is the only record of the decision.
payments.commissionSurchargeNote: Tier rate {{rate}}%, multiplied by {{multiplier}} by the driver’s cancellation rate.
